title: EcoClicker made with the help of Claude Sonnet 3.5, an idle clicker eco system simulator, what else should i add to the game?
author: kris008

comments.author: SoDavonair
comments.body: Neat demo! Right now the biggest thing that seems to be missing is entropy. Entities should starve without enough food present. Lakes should dry up over time while a rain score ticks up, etc.

replies.author: kris008
replies.body:
Hey, thanks for the feedback. I was thinking of adding some kind of hunger system in for the next update, I might try and simulate days and if they haven't eaten in so many days they will perish. 
I like the idea with the lakes and rain, I'll add it to the ideas list.
